lines.text: Previously. I passed the Hunters' exam, with Rin and a guy whose head is on fire.
Wick told me nobody has ever gone home. Not one. Not ever.
We killed a Greater Fiend that should never have been there. Somebody herded it to us.
And the axe keeps saying one word. Static.
Gideon. It is midnight. Even your gears should be asleep.
Gears never sleep, Valentine. They only wait to be useful.
What are you building?
A problem. A boy with an axe that breaks everything and protects nothing.
Our little error. Sieg told you about the block?
lines.tts: Our little error. Seeg told you about the block?

lines.text: Sieg told me the boy took a hit from a Behemoth trying to block with it. Any other Hunter would be soup.
lines.tts: Seeg told me the boy took a hit from a Behemoth trying to block with it. Any other Hunter would be soup.

lines.text: You cannot change what a Brand is, Valentine. But you can change what holds it.
Gears and chains for a three hundred year old curse. You are a romantic.
I am an engineer. It is the same thing with more burns.
Good morning, Hunters! Your first official quests!
Our first quest! What is it? A dragon? A cursed castle?
Rats in the bakery cellar.
...Rats.
Very large rats. Rank F large.
Not you, Takuto. You have a different appointment.
lines.tts: Not you, Tah-koo-toh. You have a different appointment.

lines.text: With who?
Gideon Halloway. The Guild artificer. He builds things for Hunters who can't survive without them.
You think I can't survive?
I watched you try to block a rock the size of a house with an axe that refuses to block.
Twice.
Once was a reflex.
And the second time?
...Also a reflex.
Gideon is a genius. He is also strange. Don't touch anything that ticks.
Can I come? I want to see a genius! I've only ever seen regular people!
You have rats.
I have rats.
I'll go with Takuto. Someone has to make sure he doesn't touch anything that ticks.
lines.tts: I'll go with Tah-koo-toh. Someone has to make sure he doesn't touch anything that ticks.

lines.text: Hey! Why does she get the genius and I get the rats?
Because she's rank C, and you set the last cellar on fire.
Ah! The error! Come in, come in. Don't touch anything that ticks.
Sieg said that.
lines.tts: Seeg said that.

lines.text: Sieg learned it the hard way. Ask him about his eyebrows sometime.
lines.tts: Seeg learned it the hard way. Ask him about his eyebrows sometime.

lines.text: Is that why he wears the headband?
I could not possibly say.
Arms out, boy. Let me see how you hold it.
Like this?
Like a man carrying a plank. Wonderful. Terrible. Wonderful.
Here is your problem. Ruinbreaker refuses to defend. When you raise it to block, the Brand lets go of your hands.
That's what it felt like. Like it slid out of my grip on purpose.
On purpose is exactly right. A Brand is a will, boy. Yours has opinions.
Opinions. Ha. I like this old man.
So we do not ask the Brand to block. We ask the metal.
What does that mean?
My Brand, Cogwheel Core. Anything metal I touch becomes a machine that obeys me.
A chain harness, wound into the haft. When something strikes at you, the chains lock the axe crossways, all by themselves.
So the axe can block.
Once.
Once?
Once. After that the Brand notices what we did and snaps the chains like threads. No offense, young lady.
Some offense.
Then I rewind them. That takes a night. One block per day, boy. Spend it wisely.
One block a day.
It is one more than you have now.
Why are you helping him? The Guild doesn't pay you for this.
Because thirty years ago a boy with a broken Brand came into this forge, and I told him there was nothing I could do.
What happened to him?
He believed me.
I have not said those words since. Arms out again, boy.
And you, young lady. That scarf. Let me weave steel into it. Your threads would cut through stone.
No.
No? Just no? I am offering you a masterpiece.
It was my brother's. It stays the way he wore it.
...Then I will only mend the frayed end. With his colour. Nobody will know but you.
...Thank you.
You can say thank you?
Not to you.
Okay. Rats. We can do rats. Rats are just very small Fiends with bad manners.
These are not small.
What?
Squeeeeak!
Squeak squeak squeak!
That one is wearing a hat! Why is that rat wearing a hat?!
It's a flour sack. It got stuck on its head.
It looks like a chef! It looks like a tiny angry chef!
Wick. Your head is getting brighter.
That's normal! That's what happens when I'm calm and in control!
Wick. We are standing in a room full of flour.
So?
Flour in the air burns.
...Oh no.
Run.
Sieg! Swing at him. Properly. Not your polite swing.
lines.tts: Seeg! Swing at him. Properly. Not your polite swing.

lines.text: I don't have a polite swing.
He does. I've seen the other one.
Ready?
It blocked. It actually blocked!
Of course it blocked. I built it.
Again.
Wait, he said only once...
Ow.
Once! I said once! Nobody ever listens to the engineer!
That was the best thing I've seen all week.
Good. Now you know exactly how much one block is worth. Spend it on someone else.
Someone else?
You can dodge for yourself. You can't dodge for the person standing behind you.
...Yeah. That's what it's for.
You flinched before the second swing. You knew the block was gone, and you flinched anyway.
I thought it might work twice.
Hope is not a technique, Takuto. Let me tell you about mine. Afterimage. Every cut I make, happens again a heartbeat later.
lines.tts: Hope is not a technique, Tah-koo-toh. Let me tell you about mine. Afterimage. Every cut I make, happens again a heartbeat later.

lines.text: So you hit twice.
So I have to be right twice. If my first cut is wrong, the second one is wrong in exactly the same way.
A Brand is not a gift. It is a rule. You are not strong because of it. You are strong when you stop fighting the rule.
My rule is I can't defend.
Your rule is that you must always be the one who moves first.
Every fight you've had, you waited to see what the Fiend would do. Stop waiting. Make it react to you.
Finally, someone in this world talks sense. Attack, boy. Always attack. That's what we're for.
The axe agrees with you.
...I'm not sure I like that.
Come. Gideon wants the harness back by nightfall. And I want dinner.
Quest complete! Rats defeated! Bakery mostly standing!
Mostly?
The east wall is a little bit gone.
The rats were very big! I panicked! My head panicked!
Nemu, why are you covered in flour?
lines.tts: Neh-moo, why are you covered in flour?

lines.text: I took a nap in the flour sacks. It was very soft. Then the wall exploded.
You came along to help?
I came along for the free bread. The baker gave us a reward. Burnt.
He said it was a reward. He said it while crying.
I'll put down quest complete. With an asterisk.
An asterisk! Like Takuto's star!
lines.tts: An asterisk! Like Tah-koo-toh's star!

lines.text: It is not like Takuto's star.
lines.tts: It is not like Tah-koo-toh's star.

lines.text: Where is Takuto?
lines.tts: Where is Tah-koo-toh?

lines.text: At the forge with Gideon all day. And Rin. Rin volunteered.
Rin volunteered.
Rin volunteered!
Interesting.
They were the size of dogs. Dogs, Takuto. Dogs with teeth.
lines.tts: They were the size of dogs. Dogs, Tah-koo-toh. Dogs with teeth.

lines.text: Did you set the cellar on fire?
Only a little bit.
The baker says the whole cellar.
The baker exaggerates.
What was that?!
That came from the artisans' quarter.
The forge. Gideon's forge!
Gideon! Where are you?
Here! Mind the floor! Mind the hole in the floor!
That's a Rift. Inside a building.
Rifts open in the sky. Everyone keeps saying that.
Shieldbearer! In the middle of town!
It came through the floor. Someone opened that. I felt it, like a key turning in a lock.
Out of the way!
It's faster than the one in the canyon!
The fire's spreading to the coal store! If that goes up, the whole street goes!
Wick, can you pull the fire back?
I can tell my fire what to do! That fire isn't mine!
The bellows! Smash the bellows and it will starve of air!
Smashing things isn't my department!
Then I'll hold it! Takuto, the bellows!
lines.tts: Then I'll hold it! Tah-koo-toh, the bellows!

lines.text: It broke the threads! Gideon, move!
My knee! I can't, my knee is fused! Bad joint!
Get behind me!
You spent it on the old man? Ha!
That's what it's for.
You... you used it on me.
You built it. It's only fair.
Then let me return the favor. Cogwheel Core!
Every chain in this forge is mine! Bind it!
And burn it! Only it!
Ruinbreaker!
The Rift is closing.
Something's on the other side of the smoke.
Good catch.
Who was that?! There was someone there, in a suit!
He was smiling.
Static, boy. Didn't I tell you? He smells like static.
A Rift. Inside the walls of Ashford. Opened sideways, through a floor.
That's twice now. Once at the boy's crossing. Once here.
It was opened from this side. Like a door. Someone stood in my forge and turned a key.
There was a man. In a black suit. In the smoke. He said good catch.
...What did he look like?
I couldn't see a face. Just a grin. Like lightning. And one eye.
Sieg. Say it.
lines.tts: Seeg. Say it.

lines.text: Six years ago, my squad was holding the pass at Grey Hollow. The night before Morvudd came, a man walked into our camp.
Black suit. No face. He asked us which way the wind was blowing, and then he was gone.
By morning there was a Rift above the pass, and I was the only one left.
You think it's the same man.
I think he opens doors for monsters. And I think he's interested in you.
Then he made a mistake tonight. He showed us his face.
He showed us his grin, Gideon. That is not the same thing.
What do we do?
We get stronger. Faster than he expects.
And I rewind the chains. Tomorrow, boy, you'll have your one block again.
Thanks, Gideon.
Thank you. You spent it well.
Before you sleep, darling. Tofu wants to look at the harness. He has been jealous all evening.
He's a cube.
He is a very sensitive cube.
Error. As always. But look, a smaller error.
A smaller error?
Gideon's chains are holding part of your Brand still. Tofu can almost read it now. Almost.
...How strange. There are two signatures on this axe, Takuto. Two wills. Like two people holding the same handle.
lines.tts: ...How strange. There are two signatures on this axe, Tah-koo-toh. Two wills. Like two people holding the same handle.

lines.text: Clever box. Tell it to mind its own business.
It's an old axe. Lots of people held it.
Mm. Lots of people. Of course.
Good night, Takuto. If the other one ever wants to talk, Tofu and I are excellent listeners.
lines.tts: Good night, Tah-koo-toh. If the other one ever wants to talk, Tofu and I are excellent listeners.

lines.text: Rewound. Tighter than before. You'll feel it pull when it locks.
Your forge is gone, Gideon. You stayed up rewinding my chains?
An engineer without a forge is still an engineer. I did it on the fountain.
He did. The town guard tried to arrest him twice.
And you, flame boy. Hold out your hands.
Me? Why me?
Gloves. Woven steel. Your fire obeys you, but your hands are still made of meat. These will hold heat, and throw it.
Throw it? I can THROW fire now?
You can aim it. Whether you hit anything is between you and your gods.
Thank you! Thank you! Nobody ever gives me presents! I'll name them! Left one's Takoyaki!
Please do not name the gloves.
Right one's also Takoyaki.
Thank you for the shield, boy. I meant it. I've built a thousand things. Nobody ever stood in front of me with one.
Build a thousand and one. I'll keep standing there.
The man in the suit. Rin told me.
Rin tells you everything.
Rin tells me nothing. I listen at doors.
I saw a man like that once. When I was little. Before my first life.
Where?
My village. He stood in the square and asked which way the wind was blowing. The next day, a Rift.
That was the first time I died.
...Nemu.
lines.tts: ...Neh-moo.

lines.text: It's okay. It was a long time ago. I just... if he's looking at you, I don't want to die again for nothing.
You're not dying again. I'll break him first.
You can't break everything, Takuto.
lines.tts: You can't break everything, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: Watch me.
...Mm. I'll watch.
You didn't hesitate. With Gideon.
Sieg told me what it was for.
lines.tts: Seeg told me what it was for.

lines.text: My brother would have done the same thing.
Then I'm in good company.
...You're not him, you know.
I know.
He was taller.
Of course he was.
That man in the suit. If he comes after you, he comes after all of us.
Since when are you part of us?
Since I got commended for keeping you alive. I'm not letting you ruin my record.
She's fond of you, boy. Humans are so loud about it, even when they say nothing.
...Shut up.
What?
Not you.
He spent his one block on an old man. Sentimental.
The Saint will want to meet him. Sooner than he planned.
Next time: the river town of Marrowmere.
There's a Hydra in the lake. Every head I cut off grows back.
Breaking a thing and killing it turn out to be different problems.
Episode five. Seven Heads, One River.
